segments.an7.27:1.2: Taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha … pe ….
segments.an7.27:1.3: Katame ca, bhikkhave, satta aparihāniyā dhammā?
segments.an7.27:1.4: Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū aniccasaññaṃ bhāvessanti; vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
segments.an7.27:2.1: “Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū anattasaññaṃ bhāvessanti … pe … asubhasaññaṃ bhāvessanti … ādīnavasaññaṃ bhāvessanti … pahānasaññaṃ bhāvessanti … virāgasaññaṃ bhāvessanti … nirodhasaññaṃ bhāvessanti;
segments.an7.27:3.1: vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni. “Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu, bhikkhū sandississanti; vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihānī”ti [dī. ni.2.138].
